maria.g: heads up — after the KMS rotation last night, a few Okta tenants started getting SCIM 500s on patch updates. noticed at ~23:45 UTC. :eyes:
ajay.s: which tenants? pattern?
maria.g: all are service-account provisioning with externalId canonicalization + had RBAC role renames last week. about 6 tenants so far.
kevin_l: sample errors from provisioning service logs: `kms: decrypt failed: invalid key version` and downstream `scim: malformed JWE external_id`
idp-admin: malformed JWE typically means ciphertext wasn't properly re-encrypted with the new key. Did the DB re-encrypt job finish?
maria.g: it ran but errored on ~2% of rows — timeouts to KMS. We retried the job but missed some rate-limited failures.
ajay.s: paste minimal trace?
maria.g: ```
2026-03-20T23:46:02Z svc/provisioner auth.go:142: decrypt external_id failed: kms.Decrypt error: NotFoundException key id not found
2026-03-20T23:46:02Z svc/provisioner scim.go:87: apply patch -> 500 internal: malformed external_id JWE
```
kevin_l: mitigation options: 1) temporary gate to pause SCIM delta pushes for affected tenants; 2) requeue failed re-encrypt rows with backoff and bump KMS quota; 3) alter HTTP response for transient decrypt failures to 429 so IdP retries are rate-limited rather than triggering 500 error pages.
idp-admin: we can respond 429, but Okta retries aggressively — better mark the provisioner as degraded and pause delta pushes to avoid mass retries.
ajay.s: timeline hypothesis — role rename caused re-eval of external_id canonicalization so some rows entered re-encrypt path; when KMS calls failed we left ciphertext untouched; later code expected a plaintext JWE and attempted parse -> malformed JWE.
maria.g: audit logs corroborate — RBAC audit deltas at 23:30 that match affected rows.
kevin_l: action list: pause deltas for those tenants, requeue failed re-encrypt rows (job rj-20260321-01), increase KMS throughput for retries, add defensive handling in provisioner: if KMS decrypt fails -> surface as transient and return 429 plus remediation ticket id. Also add pre-check for ciphertext version header (`v=`) and skip rows missing header for manual triage.
ajay.s: I'll open an incident (P2) and assign infra-crypto + identity to investigate.
idp-admin: quick SQL to enumerate rows: `SELECT id FROM provisioning WHERE external_id LIKE 'jwe:%' AND reencrypt_status='failed' LIMIT 1000;`
maria.g: running now — ~240 rows across 6 tenants.
kevin_l: customer comms draft: "We identified SCIM provisioning failures after a KMS rotation affecting a subset of updates. We're pausing deltas and replaying a targeted re-encrypt. No customer data was exposed. We'll notify when deltas resume"
ajay.s: update runbook: add step to monitor KMS throttling during rekey and record failed ids for manual retry. current runbook assumes 100% success.
idp-admin: one more gotcha — check service-account SCIM tokens TTL before replay; short-lived tokens may cause replay to fail.
maria.g: tokens verified, requeue started (rj-20260321-01).
kevin_l: post-fix, backfill audit events to indicate which external_id blobs were rekeyed and which were skipped so compliance can reconcile.
ajay.s: agreed. I'll coordinate comms and postmortem. assigning to @kevin_l, @maria.g and infra-crypto.
maria.g: will produce remediation checklist and PR for runbook changes. :thumbsup:
